title: SanadRecord
description: Sanad Chain & Transmission Verification Schema [REPOSITORY VERIFIED — CONTRACT-NEUTRAL per Decision #1 (2026-08-01)]. The public contract exposes domain-neutral semantic fields. The internal persistence field `SanadRecord.qiraahType` is intentionally NOT exposed as a generic type; see $comment for the explicit persistence → contract mapping.

sanadType.description: Semantic classification of the sanad/credential (e.g., Qira'at, Hadith, Tahsin, Tajwid sanad). Mapped from the internal `qiraahType` persistence value BY DOMAIN MEANING, never by field name. Enumeration is intentionally not closed — exact controlled vocabulary is pending domain review.

knowledgeDomain.description: The general area of Islamic knowledge (e.g., Qira'at, Fiqh, Hadith)

credentialName.description: Name of the credential, ijazah, or authorization

domainMetadata.description: Optional domain-specific metadata. For Qira'at records this MAY carry a qiraah-specific attribute; kept generic to avoid leaking the internal column name as a public type.

examples.chainDescription: Bersambung 30 generasi sampai Rasulullah SAW melalui Syaikh Dr. Ayman Suwaid.

$comment: Decision #1 mapping (internal `SanadRecord.qiraahType` → public `sanadType`/`knowledgeDomain`), mapped by domain meaning: qiraahType=HAFSH_AN_ASHIM / QIRAAT_SANAD → sanadType QIRAAT_SANAD (knowledgeDomain Qira'at); HADITS_SANAD → HADITS_SANAD (knowledgeDomain Hadith); TAHSIN → Tahsin classification; TAJWID → Tajwid classification. This is a documentation mapping only — no DB migration, no runtime rename (Decision #1 APPROVED 2026-08-01).
